content.title: Better.com CEO talks growth outlook, AI underwriting, Fed rates
content.description:
Better Home & Finance (BETR) — which does business as Better.com — shares have blasted off by nearly 75% in this trading week alone after EMJ Capital's Eric Jackson likened the company to being "the Shopify of mortgages" and revealed a long position in the stock.

Better.com CEO Vishal Garg sits down with Opening Bid host Allie Canal to discuss the company's path to reach profitability by late 2026, implementing AI in its mortgage lending, the Federal Reserve's latest cut to interest rates, and what's differentiating the company's growth from meme stock trends.

Also read up on what Robinhood CIO Stephanie Guild has to say about the trading trends around stocks like Better Home and Opendoor Technologies (OPEN).

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Opening Bid.
